title: 2. Test whether search needs grasp-and-lift-aware selection
hypothesis: When pick-place success is sparse, ranking successful grasp-and-lift behaviour ahead of geometric goal progress selects more transferable controllers from the same rollout candidates.

prediction.rationale: Baseline is the unchanged phase-searchability selector applied to the identical candidate pool. A 10-point confirmation gain would identify candidate selection, rather than generation or additional search, as a pipeline bottleneck; sharing all search rollouts makes this inexpensive.

code_changes: scripts/compare_generation_modes.py (--research-mode pick-place-suite: shared controls, lift-aware selector, grounding table, two-phase counterparts)

falsified_by: The block-level paired 95% interval has an upper bound below +0.10. A zero-spanning interval is inconclusive; the resolving measurement is fresh-case paired success of the two selectors' winners over additional independent structure pools.
